name: wp-angular-cms
description: Headless WordPress + Express BFF + Angular monorepo

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cms/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @cms/api" "npm run dev -w @cms/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @cms/shared && npm run dev -w @cms/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cms/shared && npm run build -w @cms/api && npm run build -w @cms/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cms/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cms/api && npm run typecheck -w @cms/web
